answer: Copying the same citations across 219 aliases therefore forfeits the authoring cost 219 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the terrace index resolves every citation against the orchard checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the island audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 4392 identities would post 579 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
